title: IELTS Speaking Part 3: Environment — Simple Present
titleVi: IELTS Speaking Part 3: Môi trường — Thì Hiện Tại Đơn

speakingCueCard.prompt: What do people in your country do to protect the environment?

questionPrompt: Read the speaking response below. Select every grammar error you notice by highlighting it. You may also type the correct version in the box that appears.
questionPromptVi: Đọc đoạn văn dưới đây. Chọn mỗi lỗi ngữ pháp bạn phát hiện bằng cách bôi đen. Bạn có thể gõ bản sửa đúng vào ô hiện ra.
passageText: Well, in my country, the government encourage people to separate their rubbish into different bins for recycling. Many families follow this rule, but some people still does not bother because they think it takes too much time. Factories also produce a large amount of pollution, and this causes serious health problems in big cities. I think each person need to take responsibility, because small actions add up over time. Looking at the bigger picture, protecting the environment requires effort from everyone in society. We all share the same planet, after all.

errors.explanation: 'The government' is singular — the verb needs -s: 'encourages'.
errors.explanationVi: 'The government' là số ít — động từ cần -s: 'encourages'.

errors.errorText: some people still does not bother
errors.correctText: some people still do not bother
acceptedAnswers: some people still do not bother
errors.explanation: 'Some people' is plural — use 'do not', not 'does not'.
errors.explanationVi: 'Some people' là số nhiều — dùng 'do not', không phải 'does not'.

errors.explanation: 'Each person' is grammatically singular — 'needs', not 'need'. 'Each' always takes a singular verb.
errors.explanationVi: 'Each person' về ngữ pháp là số ít — dùng 'needs', không phải 'need'. 'Each' luôn đi với động từ số ít.

falseAlarmZones.text: small actions add up over time
falseAlarmZones.hint: 'Actions add' is correct — 'actions' is plural, so the base form 'add' is used.

collocations.sourceInPassage: separate their rubbish into different bins
collocations.exampleSentence: In Japan, people are very careful to separate rubbish into the correct categories.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Separate rubbish' hoặc 'sort rubbish' — không dùng 'divide rubbish'

collocations.exampleSentence: Everyone should take responsibility for reducing their own carbon footprint.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Take responsibility' — không dùng 'get responsibility' hay 'have responsibility for'

collocations.sourceInPassage: small actions add up over time
collocations.translation: tích lũy dần theo thời gian
collocations.exampleSentence: Even small savings add up over time and can make a big difference.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Add up' (phrasal verb) = tích lũy — không dùng 'add up together' (thừa)

collocations.exampleSentence: We need to look at the bigger picture when discussing environmental policy.
collocations.grammarNote: 'The bigger picture' — tự nhiên hơn 'the big picture' trong IELTS discussion
